<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>wakehealth.edu Wake Forest Baptist Health</query>

Based on my search, **wakehealth.edu** is the official website for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, an academic health system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Here are the key details:

## Overview

- **Name**: Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist (formerly Wake Forest Baptist Health)
- **Location**: Winston-Salem, North Carolina
- **Type**: Academic medical center and health system
- **Affiliation**: Part of Atrium Health (since 2021), and affiliated with Wake Forest School of Medicine

## Key Components

- **Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center** – The flagship 885-bed academic medical center
- **Wake Forest School of Medicine** – The medical school that is part of the system
- **Brenner Children's Hospital** – A pediatric hospital within the system
- **Comprehensive Cancer Center** – One of the nation's leading NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Centers

## History and Merger

In 2021, Wake Forest Baptist Health merged with **Atrium Health** (based in Charlotte, NC), creating one of the largest health systems in the region. The organization retained its academic mission and Wake Forest School of Medicine branding while becoming part of the larger Atrium Health enterprise.

## Services

The health system provides:
- Tertiary and quaternary care
- Medical education and research
- Community hospitals and outpatient services across North Carolina

The website wakehealth.edu serves as the patient portal and information hub for accessing medical records, finding providers, scheduling appointments, and learning about medical services.

Sources:
1. https://www.wakehealth.edu/
2. https://www.wakehealth.edu/about-us
3. https://www.wakehealth.edu/locations/wake-forest-baptist-medical-center
